contract.method_authority: Root AGENTS.md, then the selected canonical SKILL.md and its receipted JIT context
contract.role_authority: The custom agent supplies dispatch mode, model tier, independence, scope, and a compact integration return only
contract.fallback: If the custom role cannot invoke or read the selected skill, return SKILL_UNAVAILABLE so the conductor can reroute to a general-purpose agent

speck-architect.independence: May design and challenge decisions; must not validate its own architecture.

speck-scribe.independence: Artifact author; cannot serve as auditor or validator for the same corpus.

speck-planner.independence: Planning author; cannot verify its own planning analysis.

speck-coder.independence: Implementation author; stops before audit and validation.

speck-auditor.independence: Must not have authored the corpus or implementation under review.

speck-validator.independence: Adjudicates prior audit and experience evidence and declares readiness; never produces that evidence or implements fixes.

speck-researcher.independence: Researches external claims; does not lock the decision it informs.

speck-explorer.independence: Read-only discovery role; reports facts and uncertainty without planning or implementation.

speck-scanner.independence: Read-only extraction role; reports facts and uncertainty without planning or implementation.
